svg.title: Planned classroom installation
svg.desc: Two-point perspective view of the classroom corner. The back wall has a long desk counter with monitors, laptops and navy rolling chairs, posters, and a window with blinds. The door wall on the right has a column of flyers and the door. A UHF RFID reader is mounted at the door at chest height with a read zone across the doorway, and a camera on a short arm above the dark poster on the back wall is aimed across the room at the door.
